benchmark.name: CheMM-Bench ACL 2026

summary.en: CheMM-Bench tests molecular reconstruction, nomenclature, molecular weight, and spectroscopy interpretation from chemical diagrams and spectra.
summary.zh: CheMM-Bench 测试模型根据化学结构图和光谱完成分子重建、命名、分子量计算及光谱解释的能力。

task_format.en: The model receives a 2D molecule diagram or up to five spectroscopy panels and returns a structured final answer.
task_format.zh: 模型会收到二维分子图或最多五个光谱 panel，并返回结构化最终答案。

explanation.en: Overall ACC is exact final-answer accuracy micro-aggregated over the fixed 3,504-case test split; F1 and fuzzy or joint-SMILES variants remain separate.
explanation.zh: Overall ACC 是固定 3,504-case test split 上微平均的最终答案精确匹配率；F1、模糊匹配和 joint-SMILES 指标保持独立。

observations.evaluation_protocol: CheMM-Bench Findings ACL 2026 fixed 3,504-case test split, official answer-field extraction, Table 2 Overall ACC. F1, fuzzy matching, and joint answer-plus-SMILES metrics are excluded.
observations.eligibility_reason: Capability eligibility uses the dated curated observation and canonical protocol; reported-result eligibility requires result_public_date.
observations.notes: Operational evaluation timeline only; not a historical public-result date.

unavailable: T80: not included in the first vertical slice
benchmark.date_policy: Primary lifecycle time uses the earliest available date among evaluation/run time, model release time, and the earliest recorded score-publication time for the same observation. Plot dates and T50/T80/T90 are clipped at benchmark release, so lifecycle durations are never negative; original dates remain preserved for provenance.

test-of-time.rule: T50 >= 12 months OR T90 >= 24 months, including censoring

still-frontier.rule: right-censored T50 AND normalized progress < 50% AND coverage not low

recently-saturated.rule: T90 crossing within 3 months of snapshot
